    Moodle Dashboard

    Starred courses

    Any courses that you ‘star’ from the My Courses page will appear on the Starred Courses block on the dashboard for quick access Please note: you may not see anything populated on this block if accessing Moodle for the first time)

    Customise your Dashboard

    • Select Edit Mode from the top right navigation bar
    • Select Add a Block

    Hide, delete or make changes to content blocks

    • In Edit Mode select the cogwheel at the top right of the content block.
    • Select Configure, Hide or Delete.
    • In Edit Mode you can Reset to Default to return your page layout to this one.
